pairs.he: בכל דור חולקים על הצדיקים הגדולים שעוסקים לקרב נפשות הרחוקות להקב״ה
pairs.en: In every generation they dispute with the great tzaddikim who occupy themselves with drawing distant souls near to the Holy One, blessed be He.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת כְּלַל הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבְּכָל דּוֹר עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים הַשְּׁלֵמִים הָעוֹסְקִים לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקִים לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁרַבִּים מְאֹד קָמִים עֲלֵיהֶם, וְגַם רַבִּים מִגְּדוֹלֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים חוֹלְקִים עֲלֵיהֶם מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמִּדַּת הַדִּין מִתְלַבֵּשׁ בָּהֶם וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִכְנָס בְּלִבָּם שִׂנְאָה עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לָהֶם כְּאִלּוּ אֵינוֹ מִתְנַהֵג כָּרָאוּי וְחוֹלְקִים עָלָיו.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the totality of the dispute in every generation against the complete tzaddikim who occupy themselves with drawing distant souls near to the Lord, blessed be He: very many rise against them, and also many of the great tzaddikim dispute with them, because the attribute of judgment clothes itself in them. And through this hatred enters their hearts, until it seems to them as though he does not conduct himself properly, and they dispute with him.

pairs.he: כַּאֲשֶׁר כְּבָר הָיָה לְעוֹלָמִים בְּרֹב הַדּוֹרוֹת. וּבִפְרָט בְּיָמֵינוּ בְּעִקְבוֹת מְשִׁיחָא שֶׁנִּתְרַבָּה הַקַּטֵּגוֹרְיָא בֵּין הַתַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים מְאֹד. וּבְיוֹתֵר עַל רַבֵּנוּ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא זצוק״ל עַל אֲשֶׁר מָסַר נַפְשׁוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וְעָסַק כָּל יָמָיו לְרַחֵם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כָּל הָרְחוֹקִים לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.
pairs.en: As has already happened in former times in most generations. And particularly in our days, in the footsteps of the Messiah, when contention among the Torah scholars has greatly increased; and especially against our great and awesome Rabbainu, of blessed holy and righteous memory, because he put his soul in jeopardy and occupied himself all his days with having compassion upon Israel, upon all the distant ones, to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁל הַשְּׁבָטִים עַל יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק, כִּי יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמּוֹסִיף וְהוֹלֵךְ הָאוֹר בְּכָל יוֹם, כִּי עוֹשֶׂה בְּכָל פַּעַם צִמְצוּמִים וְכֵלִים נִפְלָאִים בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לְהִתְקָרֵב כָּל מִי שֶׁיִּרְצֶה בָּעוֹלָם. וְעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת מוֹסִיף וְהוֹלֵךְ כַּנַּ״ל. וְהַשְּׁבָטִים אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכֻּלָּם קְדוֹשִׁים, כִּי הָיוּ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים, חָלְקוּ עָלָיו בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the dispute of the tribes against Yosef the tzaddik, for Yosef is the aspect of the tzaddik who occupies himself with drawing people near to the Lord, blessed be He, through continually adding to the light each day. For each time he makes wondrous contractions and vessels, in a manner in which anyone in the world who wishes can draw near. And on account of this he is called Yosef, the aspect of continually adding, as above. And the tribes, although they were all holy, for they were all great tzaddikim, disputed with him because of this.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מדרש רבה) שֶׁהָיָה מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים, (כמובא בדבריו ז"ל ח"א סימן רכ"ח). וְזֶה ׳אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף׳. הַיְנוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו יַעֲקֹב וְהָיָה עוֹסֵק גַּם כֵּן לְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים וּלְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקוֹת, כִּי כָּל מַה שֶּׁאֵרַע לְיַעֲקֹב אֵרַע לְיוֹסֵף, שֶׁזֶּה פֵּרוּשׁ אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף, כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שָׁם. שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁקִּבֵּל מִשֵּׁם וָעֵבֶר מָסַר לוֹ, וְכָל מַה שֶּׁאֵרַע יַעֲקֹב אֵרַע לְיוֹסֵף וְכוּ׳. וְכָל זֶה נִסְמָךְ לְפָסוּק ׳מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ שֶׁהוּא מַה שֶּׁהָיָה יַעֲקֹב מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים. וְתֵכֶף נִסְמָךְ אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף, שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ שֶׁמָּסַר לוֹ כָּל חָכְמָתוֹ כַּנַּ״ל, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “And Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings”; and our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded (Midrash Rabbah) that he would convert converts (as cited in his words, of blessed memory, part 1, section 228). And this is “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef.” Namely, Yosef walked in the way of his father Yaakov and also occupied himself with converting converts and drawing distant souls near, for everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef. This is the explanation of “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef,” as Rash״i explained there: that everything that he had received from Shem and Ever he transmitted to him, and everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef, etc. And all this is placed beside the verse “his father’s sojournings,” which is Yaakov’s converting converts; and immediately “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef” is placed beside it, meaning that he transmitted all his wisdom to him, as above—namely, as above.

pairs.he: כְּמוֹ שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב גִּיֵּר גֵּרִים עַל יְדֵי עֹצֶם חָכְמָתוֹ שֶׁהָיָה יוֹדֵעַ לַעֲשׂוֹת צִמְצוּמִים כָּאֵלֶּה עַד שֶׁיּוּכַל לְרַפְּאוֹת הַחוֹלִים בְּיוֹתֵר, כְּמוֹ כֵן הָיָה יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק בָּזֶה תָּמִיד, כִּי יַעֲקֹב מָסַר לוֹ כָּל חָכְמָתוֹ, כִּי עִקַּר הַחָכְמָה הוּא לְהַכְנִיס הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת בָּעוֹלָם לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: Just as Yaakov converted converts through the might of his wisdom, for he knew how to make such contractions until he could heal those who were most ill, so Yosef the tzaddik continually occupied himself with this, for Yaakov transmitted all his wisdom to him. For the principal wisdom is to bring apprehensions of Godliness into the world, to make His mighty deeds known to the sons of man, etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה רוֹעֶה אֶת אֶחָיו בַּצֹּאן, ׳רוֹעֶה צֹאן׳ זֶה בְּחִינַת מַנְהִיג הַדּוֹר שֶׁנִּקְרָא בְּכָל מָקוֹם בְּשֵׁם רוֹעֶה צֹאן. וְזֶה ׳בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה׳ וְכוּ׳. שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ׳טוֹב׳ כַּמּוּבָא, הַיְנוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף הָיָה טוֹב לַכֹּל וְהָיָה כֻּלּוֹ טוֹב וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה יָכוֹל לְקָרֵב הַכֹּל, כִּי מָצָא מִגֹּרַע שֶׁבַּגְּרוּעִים נְקֻדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה קֵרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “Yosef, seventeen years old, was shepherding his brothers among the sheep”: “shepherd of sheep” is the aspect of the leader of the generation, who is everywhere called a shepherd of sheep. And this is “he was seventeen years old,” etc. Seventeen is the numerical value of “good,” as cited; namely, Yosef was good to everyone and was wholly good. And through this he could draw everyone near, for he found good points in the worst of the worst, and through this drew them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהֵם בְּנֵי הַשְּׁפָחוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּחוֹת הַיְּרוּדוֹת שֶׁבְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהָיָה מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּיוֹתֵר כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם. וְעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָאִים הָרְחוֹקִים בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה, זֶה רֶמֶז שֶׁנֶּאֱחַז בָּהֶם בְּיוֹתֵר הַבַּעַל דָּבָר וְחֵילוֹתָיו. שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת ׳בְּנֵי בִלְהָה׳, בְּחִינַת בַּלָּהוֹת אֶתֵּן אוֹתָךְ וְכוּ׳ (יחזקאל כו) וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שָׁם, שֵׁדִים, הַיְנוּ חֵילוֹת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁהֵם שֵׁדִים וּקְלִפּוֹת, שֶׁהֵם מְבַלְבְּלִים וּמְבַהֲלִים וּמַרְשִׁיעִים אֶת הָאָדָם. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה׳ בְּחִינַת ׳זַלְעָפָה אֲחָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים׳ (תהלים קיט). כִּי חֵילוֹת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע הֵם בְּחִינַת בַּלָּהוֹת וְזַלְעָפוֹת וְכָל הַנֶּאֱחָזִים וְהַנִּמְשָׁכִים נִקְרָאִים בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה.
pairs.en: And this is “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc.: they are the sons of the bondwomen, the aspect of the lowly families among Israel, to whom he would lower himself especially in order to draw them near. And on account of this the distant ones are called sons of Bilhah and sons of Zilpah: this hints that the adversary and his forces have an especially strong hold on them. This is the aspect of “sons of Bilhah,” the aspect of “I shall make you terrors,” etc. (Ezekiel 26); and Rash״i explained there: demons—namely, the forces of the evil inclination, which are demons and klipos, that confuse, terrify, and cause a person to act wickedly. And this is the aspect of “sons of Zilpah,” the aspect of “Horror has seized me because of the wicked” (Psalms 119). For the forces of the evil inclination are the aspect of terrors and horrors, and all those held and drawn by them are called sons of Bilhah and sons of Zilpah.

And this is the aspect of “sons of Zilpah,” the aspect of “Horror has seized me because of the wicked” (Psalms 119). For the forces of the evil inclination are the aspect of terrors and horrors, and all those held and drawn by them are called sons of Bilhah and sons of Zilpah.

pairs.he: וְהַצַּדִּיק הַגָּדוֹל, בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף, עוֹסֵק עִמָּהֶם וּמוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה ׳וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה׳ וְכוּ׳. וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שֶׁהָיָה עוֹשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂה נַעֲרוּת וְכוּ׳. כִּי הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת בְּעֹצֶם חָכְמָתוֹ מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם כָּל כָּךְ עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה כְּאִלּוּ עוֹשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂה נַעֲרוּת, כִּי מְדַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם שִׂיחַת חֻלִּין וְאוֹכֵל וְשׁוֹתֶה עִמָּהֶם וּפְעָמִים מְטַיֵּל וּמְשַׂחֵק עִמָּהֶם וְכָל כַּוָּנָתוֹ כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְכַמּוּבָן בִּדְבָרָיו ז״ל בְּכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת (ח״א סימן ר״ב ח״ב סימן עח) כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה הַצַּדִּיק מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֶל הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נֶחְשָׁב אֶצְלוֹ מַעֲשֵׂה נַעֲרוּת, אֲבָל כַּוָּנָתוֹ רְצוּיָה לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל לְקָרֵב הָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְקָרְבָם כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי זֶה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה וְכוּ׳ וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And the great tzaddik, the aspect of Yosef, occupies himself with them and lowers himself to them in order to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc. And Rash״i explained that he would engage in youthful conduct, etc. For the true tzaddik, in the might of his wisdom, lowers himself to them so much that it seems as though he engages in youthful conduct: for he speaks ordinary conversation with them, eats and drinks with them, and sometimes strolls and plays with them. And his entire intention is to draw them near through this to the Lord, blessed be He. And it is understood from his words, of blessed memory, in several places (part 1, section 202; part 2, section 78), how very much the tzaddik lowers himself to the world, all of which is regarded by him as youthful conduct; but his intention is desired by the Lord, blessed be He, for it is to draw those very distant, who cannot be drawn near except through this, near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is the aspect of “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc., as above.

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת ׳אָסַף אֱלֹקִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִי׳ שֶׁמְּאַסֵּף וּמְבַטֵּל כָּל הַחֲרָפוֹת וּבּוּשׁוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, כִּי מַחֲזִירָם בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּמְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן׳ שֶׁעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק תָּמִיד לְהוֹסִיף וּלְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת חֲדָשׁוֹת בְּכָל פַּעַם וּמְבַקֵּשׁ תָּמִיד מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל זֶה, בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר, שֶׁיּוֹסֵף ה׳ לוֹ בְּכָל פַּעַם תַּלְמִיד חָדָשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא בֵּן, כִּי כָּל הַמְלַמֵּד בֶּן חֲבֵרוֹ תּוֹרָה כְּאִלּוּ יְלָדוֹ (סנהדרין צט). וְהוּא מְחַפֵּשׂ וּמְבַקֵּשׁ תָּמִיד לְהוֹסִיף וּלְקָרֵב חֲדָשִׁים בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר.
pairs.en: And therefore he is called Yosef, the aspect of “God has gathered away my reproach,” for he gathers away and nullifies all the reproaches and shames from Israel, because he brings them back in repentance and draws them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is the aspect of “May the Lord add a son for me,” on account of which he is called Yosef. Namely, the tzaddik continually occupies himself with adding and drawing new souls near each time, and continually asks the Lord, blessed be He, for this: the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me”—that the Lord should add for him each time a new student, who is called a son, for whoever teaches his fellow’s son Torah is as though he begot him (Sanhedrin 99). And he continually searches and seeks to add and draw new ones near, the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me.”

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן ׳וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת יוֹסֵף מִכָּל בָּנָיו כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳ שֶׁאָהַב אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה מְאֹד, כִּי הוּא חָפֵץ בָּזֶה לְרַחֵם עַל הַכֹּל וְלַעֲשׂוֹת תַּחְבּוּלוֹת לְקָרֵב הַכֹּל. וְזֶה ׳כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳. זָקֵן זֶה בְּחִינַת רַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים מְאֹד בְּחִינַת זָקֵן מָלֵא רַחֲמִים, בְּחִינַת תְּלֵיסַר תִּקּוּנֵי דִּיקְנָא שֶׁהֵם רַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים מְאֹד. הַיְנוּ שֶׁקִּבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ כָּל שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה מִדּוֹת שֶׁל רַחֲמִים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת זָקֵן כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הוּא מְרַחֵם עַל הַכֹּל וּמְקָרֵב כֻּלָּם. וְזֶה שֶׁתִּרְגֵּם אֻנְקְלוֹס, כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים, כִּי בַר חַכִּים הוּא לֵיהּ. בַּר חַכִּים וַדַּאי, כִּי צְרִיכִין לָזֶה חָכְמָה גְּדוֹלָה חָכְמָה נִפְלָאָה חָכְמָה עֲמֻקָּה מְאֹד מְאֹד כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּלִים וְצִמְצוּמִים כָּאֵלֶּה שֶׁיּוּכַל לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת רְחוֹקוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה חוֹלִים כָּאֵלֶּה וּלְהַכְנִיס בָּהֶם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And therefore “And Israel loved Yosef more than all his sons, for he was a son of old age to him”: he loved him very much because of this, for he desires this, to have compassion upon everyone and to devise stratagems to draw everyone near. And this is “For he was a son of old age to him.” An elder is the aspect of very great mercies, the aspect of an elder full of mercies, the aspect of the thirteen rectifications of the beard, which are very great mercies. Namely, he received from him all thirteen attributes of mercy, which are the aspect of an elder, as above, for through this he has compassion upon everyone and draws them all near. And this is what Onkelos translated: “For he was a son of old age”—“for he was a wise son to him.” A wise son indeed, for this requires great wisdom, wondrous wisdom, very, very deep wisdom, so that he can make such vessels and contractions that he can draw such distant souls near, such ill people, and bring apprehensions of Godliness into them, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore “And Israel loved Yosef more than all his sons, for he was a son of old age to him”: he loved him very much because of this, for he desires this, to have compassion upon everyone and to devise stratagems to draw everyone near. pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳וְעָשָׂה לוֹ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים׳. שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ כְּלִי מֵילַת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ גְּוָנִין יָפִים, בְּחִינַת צֶמֶר וּתְכֵלֶת, הַיְנוּ מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה עוֹסֵק בָּזֶה לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקוֹת, עַל כֵּן עָשָׂה לוֹ לְבוּשִׁים נִפְלָאִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּם גְּוָנִין יָפִים וּנְכוֹנִים וְנִפְלָאִים בְּחִינַת כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים. הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים נִפְלָאִים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עַל יָדָם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת אֲפִלּוּ לְהָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד וְכַנַּ״ל. כִּי בְּחִינַת הַצִּמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת חָכְמָה תַּתָּאָה הַנַּ״ל הֵם כְּלוּלִים מִכָּל הַגְּוָנִין, שֶׁהֵם כְּלַל כָּל הַכֵּלִים וְהַלְּבוּשִׁין שֶׁל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁעַל יָדָם מַשִּׂיגִין אֱלֹקוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים, וְאִיהִי כְּלִילָא מִכָּל הַגְּוָנִין.
pairs.en: And this is “And he made him a striped tunic,” whose meaning is a garment of fine wool with beautiful colors, the aspect of wool and blue thread. Namely, because he occupied himself with this, drawing distant souls near, therefore he made him wondrous garments with beautiful, proper, and wondrous colors, the aspect of a striped tunic. Namely, the aspect of wondrous contractions, which are the aspect of vessels and garments, so that through them he can draw apprehensions of Godliness even to those very distant, as above. For the aspect of these contractions, which are the aspect of the lower wisdom mentioned above, comprise all the colors, which are the totality of all the vessels and garments of holiness through which His Godliness, blessed be He, is apprehended, as is written in the holy Zohar several times: “And she comprises all the colors.”

pairs.he: וְזֶה שֶׁחָלְמוּ ׳וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶה׳ שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ קְשָׁרִים, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת קְשָׁרִים, כִּי הַצִּמְצוּם בְּחִינַת קֶשֶׁר. הַיְנוּ שֶׁכֻּלָּם הָיוּ עוֹסְקִים בָּזֶה, שֶׁהָיוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים וְעוֹשִׂים קְשָׁרִים וְצִמְצוּמִים כְּדֵי לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עַל יָדָם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת, אֲבָל הַצִּמְצוּמִים וְהַכֵּלִים שֶׁל יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק עָלָה עַל כֻּלָּם, בִּבְחִינַת (שם) ׳וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה׳ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהַקֶּשֶׁר וְהַצִּמְצוּם שֶׁלּוֹ קָמָה וְגַם נִצְּבָה לָעַד וּלָנֶצַח.
pairs.en: And this is what they dreamed: “And behold, we are binding sheaves within the field,” whose meaning is bonds—namely, the aspect of the contractions mentioned above, which are the aspect of bonds, for contraction is the aspect of a bond. Namely, they all occupied themselves with this, binding sheaves and making bonds and contractions in order to draw through them apprehensions of Godliness. But the contractions and vessels of Yosef the tzaddik surpassed them all, in the aspect of (ibid.) “And behold, my sheaf arose and also stood,” etc., for his bond and contraction arose and also stood for all time and eternity.

Namely, they all occupied themselves with this, binding sheaves and making bonds and contractions in order to draw through them apprehensions of Godliness. pairs.he: ׳וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמּוֹתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי׳. שֶׁכֻּלָּם צְרִיכִין לְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת עַל יְדֵי הַצִּמְצוּמִים נִפְלָאִים שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה בְּחָכְמָתוֹ הָעֲמֻקָּה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת תָּמִיד. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים שֶׁעוֹסְקִין בָּזֶה לְהַשִּׂיג הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת עַל יְדֵי הַצִּמְצוּמִים, גַּם הֵם צְרִיכִין לְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ, כִּי שֶׁלּוֹ עוֹלֶה עַל כֻּלָּם בִּבְחִינַת (משלי לא) ׳רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּנָה׳ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר עַל הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת הַגָּדוֹל בְּיוֹתֵר שֶׁעוֹסֵק לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ תּוֹרָה בְּחָכְמָה אֲמִתִּית כָּזֹאת עַד שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לְהִתְקָרֵב הַכֹּל לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת הַשֶּׁבַח שֶׁל אֵשֶׁת חַיִל וְכוּ׳. בְּחִינַת דָּרְשָׁה צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים לְהַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: “And behold, your sheaves came around and bowed to my sheaf”: that they all need to receive from him apprehensions of Godliness through the wondrous contractions that he makes with his deep wisdom, through continually occupying himself with drawing souls near. Through this he attained that even the great tzaddikim who occupy themselves with this, to attain apprehensions of Godliness through contractions, also need to receive from him, for his surpasses them all, in the aspect of (Proverbs 31) “Many daughters have done valiantly, but you have surpassed them all.” This is said concerning the greatest true tzaddik, who occupies himself with making vessels and garments and drawing Torah with such true wisdom that everyone can draw near to the Lord, blessed be He. This is the aspect of the praise of a woman of valor, etc., the aspect of “She sought wool and flax,” which are the aspect of vessels and garments for apprehensions of Godliness, etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳הָיְתָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק׳ וְכוּ׳ וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ׳ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁבְּתוֹקֶף חֶשְׁכַת לֵיל הַגָּלוּת שֶׁל נְפָשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הִיא נוֹתֶנֶת לָהֶם טֶרֶף וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן הוֹלֵךְ וְסוֹבֵב כָּל הַשֶּׁבַח הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳נוֹדַע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ׳, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת שְׁעָרִין דְּאָתְוַון דְּאוֹרַיְתָא, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהוּא מַמְשִׁיךְ בְּחָכְמָתוֹ, שֶׁעַל יָדָם נוֹדַע הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּעוֹלָם, בְּחִינַת נוֹדַע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “She was like merchant ships, from afar,” etc., “And she arose while it was still night and gave food to her household,” etc. For in the intensity of the darkness of the night of exile of the souls of Israel, she gives them food, etc. And thus this entire holy praise proceeds and revolves. And this is the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” which are the aspect of gates of the letters of Torah—namely, the aspect of these contractions which he draws with his wisdom, through which the Lord, blessed be He, is known in the world, the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of “She was like merchant ships, from afar,” etc., “And she arose while it was still night and gave food to her household,” etc. For in the intensity of the darkness of the night of exile of the souls of Israel, she gives them food, etc. And thus this entire holy praise proceeds and revolves. And this is the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” which are the aspect of gates of the letters of Torah—namely, the aspect of these contractions which he draws with his wisdom, through which the Lord, blessed be He, is known in the world, the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳פִּיהָ פָּתְחָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת חֶסֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָהּ׳. וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סוטה מ״ט) זֶה הַלּוֹמֵד תּוֹרָה עַל מְנַת לְלַמְּדָהּ, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁמְּלַמֵּד תּוֹרָתוֹ לַאֲחֵרִים לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה ׳צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ׳, שֶׁצּוֹפֶה הָלוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ אֵיךְ יִתְנַהֵג לָעוֹלָם בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁלֹּא תִּכְבֶּה נֵרוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה נִשְׁאָר הַשְׁאַרַת חָכְמָתוֹ לְדוֹרֵי דּוֹרוֹת לָנֶצַח. כִּי ׳וְלֶחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל׳, כִּי לַחְמוֹ וְתוֹרָתוֹ אֵינוֹ לֶחֶם עַצְלוּת ח״ו, כִּי הָיָה זָרִיז מְאֹד מְאֹד בַּעֲבוֹדָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל כֵּן ׳קָמוּ בָנֶיהָ וַיְאַשְּׁרוּהָ׳, הֵם הַתַּלְמִידִים שֶׁנִּקְרָאִים בָּנִים שֶׁקֵּרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. ׳בַּעְלָהּ וַיְהַלְלָהּ׳ זֶה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מַסְכִּים עַל זֶה, כִּי חָפֵץ בָּזֶה שֶׁיְּקָרְבוּ כֻּלָּם אֵלָיו, כִּי חָפֵץ חֶסֶד הוּא. וְעַל כֵּן רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּנָה וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And this is “She opened her mouth with wisdom, and the Torah of kindness is upon her tongue.” And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded (Sotah 49): this is one who studies Torah in order to teach it—namely, as above, who teaches his Torah to others to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is “She watches the ways of her household”: he watches the course of his household, how he should conduct himself forever in a manner in which his lamp will never be extinguished, and in which the enduring remainder of his wisdom will remain for generations of generations, forever. For “And she shall not eat the bread of idleness,” for his bread and his Torah are not the bread of idleness, Heaven forbid, for he was very, very diligent in His service, blessed be He. Therefore “her sons arose and called her fortunate”: these are the students, called sons, whom he drew near to the Lord, blessed be He. “Her husband, and he praised her”—this is the Lord, blessed be He, for the Lord, blessed be He, agrees to this, for He desires this, that they should draw everyone near to Him, for He desires kindness. And therefore “Many daughters have done valiantly, but you have surpassed them all,” as above.

בכל דור חולקים על הצדיקים הגדולים שעוסקים לקרב נפשות הרחוקות להקב״ה

״וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו״

(לז, א)

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת כְּלַל הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבְּכָל דּוֹר עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים הַשְּׁלֵמִים הָעוֹסְקִים לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקִים לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁרַבִּים מְאֹד קָמִים עֲלֵיהֶם, וְגַם רַבִּים מִגְּדוֹלֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים חוֹלְקִים עֲלֵיהֶם מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמִּדַּת הַדִּין מִתְלַבֵּשׁ בָּהֶם וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִכְנָס בְּלִבָּם שִׂנְאָה עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לָהֶם כְּאִלּוּ אֵינוֹ מִתְנַהֵג כָּרָאוּי וְחוֹלְקִים עָלָיו.

כַּאֲשֶׁר כְּבָר הָיָה לְעוֹלָמִים בְּרֹב הַדּוֹרוֹת. וּבִפְרָט בְּיָמֵינוּ בְּעִקְבוֹת מְשִׁיחָא שֶׁנִּתְרַבָּה הַקַּטֵּגוֹרְיָא בֵּין הַתַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים מְאֹד. וּבְיוֹתֵר עַל רַבֵּנוּ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא זצוק״ל עַל אֲשֶׁר מָסַר נַפְשׁוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וְעָסַק כָּל יָמָיו לְרַחֵם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כָּל הָרְחוֹקִים לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁל הַשְּׁבָטִים עַל יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק, כִּי יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמּוֹסִיף וְהוֹלֵךְ הָאוֹר בְּכָל יוֹם, כִּי עוֹשֶׂה בְּכָל פַּעַם צִמְצוּמִים וְכֵלִים נִפְלָאִים בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לְהִתְקָרֵב כָּל מִי שֶׁיִּרְצֶה בָּעוֹלָם. וְעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת מוֹסִיף וְהוֹלֵךְ כַּנַּ״ל. וְהַשְּׁבָטִים אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכֻּלָּם קְדוֹשִׁים, כִּי הָיוּ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים, חָלְקוּ עָלָיו בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מדרש רבה) שֶׁהָיָה מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים, (כמובא בדבריו ז"ל ח"א סימן רכ"ח). וְזֶה ׳אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף׳. הַיְנוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו יַעֲקֹב וְהָיָה עוֹסֵק גַּם כֵּן לְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים וּלְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקוֹת, כִּי כָּל מַה שֶּׁאֵרַע לְיַעֲקֹב אֵרַע לְיוֹסֵף, שֶׁזֶּה פֵּרוּשׁ אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף, כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שָׁם. שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁקִּבֵּל מִשֵּׁם וָעֵבֶר מָסַר לוֹ, וְכָל מַה שֶּׁאֵרַע יַעֲקֹב אֵרַע לְיוֹסֵף וְכוּ׳. וְכָל זֶה נִסְמָךְ לְפָסוּק ׳מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ שֶׁהוּא מַה שֶּׁהָיָה יַעֲקֹב מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים. וְתֵכֶף נִסְמָךְ אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף, שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ שֶׁמָּסַר לוֹ כָּל חָכְמָתוֹ כַּנַּ״ל, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל.

כְּמוֹ שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב גִּיֵּר גֵּרִים עַל יְדֵי עֹצֶם חָכְמָתוֹ שֶׁהָיָה יוֹדֵעַ לַעֲשׂוֹת צִמְצוּמִים כָּאֵלֶּה עַד שֶׁיּוּכַל לְרַפְּאוֹת הַחוֹלִים בְּיוֹתֵר, כְּמוֹ כֵן הָיָה יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק בָּזֶה תָּמִיד, כִּי יַעֲקֹב מָסַר לוֹ כָּל חָכְמָתוֹ, כִּי עִקַּר הַחָכְמָה הוּא לְהַכְנִיס הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת בָּעוֹלָם לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וְכוּ׳.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה רוֹעֶה אֶת אֶחָיו בַּצֹּאן, ׳רוֹעֶה צֹאן׳ זֶה בְּחִינַת מַנְהִיג הַדּוֹר שֶׁנִּקְרָא בְּכָל מָקוֹם בְּשֵׁם רוֹעֶה צֹאן. וְזֶה ׳בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה׳ וְכוּ׳. שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ׳טוֹב׳ כַּמּוּבָא, הַיְנוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף הָיָה טוֹב לַכֹּל וְהָיָה כֻּלּוֹ טוֹב וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה יָכוֹל לְקָרֵב הַכֹּל, כִּי מָצָא מִגֹּרַע שֶׁבַּגְּרוּעִים נְקֻדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה קֵרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.

וְזֶה ׳וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהֵם בְּנֵי הַשְּׁפָחוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּחוֹת הַיְּרוּדוֹת שֶׁבְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהָיָה מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּיוֹתֵר כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם. וְעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָאִים הָרְחוֹקִים בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה, זֶה רֶמֶז שֶׁנֶּאֱחַז בָּהֶם בְּיוֹתֵר הַבַּעַל דָּבָר וְחֵילוֹתָיו. שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת ׳בְּנֵי בִלְהָה׳, בְּחִינַת בַּלָּהוֹת אֶתֵּן אוֹתָךְ וְכוּ׳ (יחזקאל כו) וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שָׁם, שֵׁדִים, הַיְנוּ חֵילוֹת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁהֵם שֵׁדִים וּקְלִפּוֹת, שֶׁהֵם מְבַלְבְּלִים וּמְבַהֲלִים וּמַרְשִׁיעִים אֶת הָאָדָם. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה׳ בְּחִינַת ׳זַלְעָפָה אֲחָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים׳ (תהלים קיט). כִּי חֵילוֹת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע הֵם בְּחִינַת בַּלָּהוֹת וְזַלְעָפוֹת וְכָל הַנֶּאֱחָזִים וְהַנִּמְשָׁכִים נִקְרָאִים בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה.

וְהַצַּדִּיק הַגָּדוֹל, בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף, עוֹסֵק עִמָּהֶם וּמוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה ׳וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה׳ וְכוּ׳. וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שֶׁהָיָה עוֹשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂה נַעֲרוּת וְכוּ׳. כִּי הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת בְּעֹצֶם חָכְמָתוֹ מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם כָּל כָּךְ עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה כְּאִלּוּ עוֹשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂה נַעֲרוּת, כִּי מְדַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם שִׂיחַת חֻלִּין וְאוֹכֵל וְשׁוֹתֶה עִמָּהֶם וּפְעָמִים מְטַיֵּל וּמְשַׂחֵק עִמָּהֶם וְכָל כַּוָּנָתוֹ כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְכַמּוּבָן בִּדְבָרָיו ז״ל בְּכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת (ח״א סימן ר״ב ח״ב סימן עח) כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה הַצַּדִּיק מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֶל הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נֶחְשָׁב אֶצְלוֹ מַעֲשֵׂה נַעֲרוּת, אֲבָל כַּוָּנָתוֹ רְצוּיָה לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל לְקָרֵב הָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְקָרְבָם כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי זֶה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה וְכוּ׳ וְכַנַּ״ל.

וְעַל כֵּן נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת ׳אָסַף אֱלֹקִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִי׳ שֶׁמְּאַסֵּף וּמְבַטֵּל כָּל הַחֲרָפוֹת וּבּוּשׁוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, כִּי מַחֲזִירָם בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּמְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן׳ שֶׁעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק תָּמִיד לְהוֹסִיף וּלְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת חֲדָשׁוֹת בְּכָל פַּעַם וּמְבַקֵּשׁ תָּמִיד מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל זֶה, בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר, שֶׁיּוֹסֵף ה׳ לוֹ בְּכָל פַּעַם תַּלְמִיד חָדָשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא בֵּן, כִּי כָּל הַמְלַמֵּד בֶּן חֲבֵרוֹ תּוֹרָה כְּאִלּוּ יְלָדוֹ (סנהדרין צט). וְהוּא מְחַפֵּשׂ וּמְבַקֵּשׁ תָּמִיד לְהוֹסִיף וּלְקָרֵב חֲדָשִׁים בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר.

וְעַל כֵּן ׳וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת יוֹסֵף מִכָּל בָּנָיו כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳ שֶׁאָהַב אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה מְאֹד, כִּי הוּא חָפֵץ בָּזֶה לְרַחֵם עַל הַכֹּל וְלַעֲשׂוֹת תַּחְבּוּלוֹת לְקָרֵב הַכֹּל. וְזֶה ׳כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳. זָקֵן זֶה בְּחִינַת רַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים מְאֹד בְּחִינַת זָקֵן מָלֵא רַחֲמִים, בְּחִינַת תְּלֵיסַר תִּקּוּנֵי דִּיקְנָא שֶׁהֵם רַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים מְאֹד. הַיְנוּ שֶׁקִּבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ כָּל שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה מִדּוֹת שֶׁל רַחֲמִים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת זָקֵן כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הוּא מְרַחֵם עַל הַכֹּל וּמְקָרֵב כֻּלָּם. וְזֶה שֶׁתִּרְגֵּם אֻנְקְלוֹס, כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים, כִּי בַר חַכִּים הוּא לֵיהּ. בַּר חַכִּים וַדַּאי, כִּי צְרִיכִין לָזֶה חָכְמָה גְּדוֹלָה חָכְמָה נִפְלָאָה חָכְמָה עֲמֻקָּה מְאֹד מְאֹד כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּלִים וְצִמְצוּמִים כָּאֵלֶּה שֶׁיּוּכַל לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת רְחוֹקוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה חוֹלִים כָּאֵלֶּה וּלְהַכְנִיס בָּהֶם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת וְכַנַּ״ל.

וְזֶה ׳וְעָשָׂה לוֹ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים׳. שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ כְּלִי מֵילַת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ גְּוָנִין יָפִים, בְּחִינַת צֶמֶר וּתְכֵלֶת, הַיְנוּ מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה עוֹסֵק בָּזֶה לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקוֹת, עַל כֵּן עָשָׂה לוֹ לְבוּשִׁים נִפְלָאִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּם גְּוָנִין יָפִים וּנְכוֹנִים וְנִפְלָאִים בְּחִינַת כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים. הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים נִפְלָאִים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עַל יָדָם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת אֲפִלּוּ לְהָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד וְכַנַּ״ל. כִּי בְּחִינַת הַצִּמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת חָכְמָה תַּתָּאָה הַנַּ״ל הֵם כְּלוּלִים מִכָּל הַגְּוָנִין, שֶׁהֵם כְּלַל כָּל הַכֵּלִים וְהַלְּבוּשִׁין שֶׁל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁעַל יָדָם מַשִּׂיגִין אֱלֹקוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים, וְאִיהִי כְּלִילָא מִכָּל הַגְּוָנִין.

וְזֶה שֶׁחָלְמוּ ׳וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶה׳ שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ קְשָׁרִים, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת קְשָׁרִים, כִּי הַצִּמְצוּם בְּחִינַת קֶשֶׁר. הַיְנוּ שֶׁכֻּלָּם הָיוּ עוֹסְקִים בָּזֶה, שֶׁהָיוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים וְעוֹשִׂים קְשָׁרִים וְצִמְצוּמִים כְּדֵי לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עַל יָדָם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת, אֲבָל הַצִּמְצוּמִים וְהַכֵּלִים שֶׁל יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק עָלָה עַל כֻּלָּם, בִּבְחִינַת (שם) ׳וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה׳ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהַקֶּשֶׁר וְהַצִּמְצוּם שֶׁלּוֹ קָמָה וְגַם נִצְּבָה לָעַד וּלָנֶצַח.

׳וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמּוֹתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי׳. שֶׁכֻּלָּם צְרִיכִין לְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת עַל יְדֵי הַצִּמְצוּמִים נִפְלָאִים שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה בְּחָכְמָתוֹ הָעֲמֻקָּה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת תָּמִיד. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים שֶׁעוֹסְקִין בָּזֶה לְהַשִּׂיג הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת עַל יְדֵי הַצִּמְצוּמִים, גַּם הֵם צְרִיכִין לְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ, כִּי שֶׁלּוֹ עוֹלֶה עַל כֻּלָּם בִּבְחִינַת (משלי לא) ׳רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּנָה׳ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר עַל הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת הַגָּדוֹל בְּיוֹתֵר שֶׁעוֹסֵק לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ תּוֹרָה בְּחָכְמָה אֲמִתִּית כָּזֹאת עַד שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לְהִתְקָרֵב הַכֹּל לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת הַשֶּׁבַח שֶׁל אֵשֶׁת חַיִל וְכוּ׳. בְּחִינַת דָּרְשָׁה צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים לְהַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת וְכוּ׳.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳הָיְתָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק׳ וְכוּ׳ וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ׳ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁבְּתוֹקֶף חֶשְׁכַת לֵיל הַגָּלוּת שֶׁל נְפָשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הִיא נוֹתֶנֶת לָהֶם טֶרֶף וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן הוֹלֵךְ וְסוֹבֵב כָּל הַשֶּׁבַח הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳נוֹדַע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ׳, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת שְׁעָרִין דְּאָתְוַון דְּאוֹרַיְתָא, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהוּא מַמְשִׁיךְ בְּחָכְמָתוֹ, שֶׁעַל יָדָם נוֹדַע הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּעוֹלָם, בְּחִינַת נוֹדַע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ וְכוּ׳.

וְזֶה ׳פִּיהָ פָּתְחָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת חֶסֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָהּ׳. וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סוטה מ״ט) זֶה הַלּוֹמֵד תּוֹרָה עַל מְנַת לְלַמְּדָהּ, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁמְּלַמֵּד תּוֹרָתוֹ לַאֲחֵרִים לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה ׳צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ׳, שֶׁצּוֹפֶה הָלוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ אֵיךְ יִתְנַהֵג לָעוֹלָם בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁלֹּא תִּכְבֶּה נֵרוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה נִשְׁאָר הַשְׁאַרַת חָכְמָתוֹ לְדוֹרֵי דּוֹרוֹת לָנֶצַח. כִּי ׳וְלֶחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל׳, כִּי לַחְמוֹ וְתוֹרָתוֹ אֵינוֹ לֶחֶם עַצְלוּת ח״ו, כִּי הָיָה זָרִיז מְאֹד מְאֹד בַּעֲבוֹדָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל כֵּן ׳קָמוּ בָנֶיהָ וַיְאַשְּׁרוּהָ׳, הֵם הַתַּלְמִידִים שֶׁנִּקְרָאִים בָּנִים שֶׁקֵּרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. ׳בַּעְלָהּ וַיְהַלְלָהּ׳ זֶה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מַסְכִּים עַל זֶה, כִּי חָפֵץ בָּזֶה שֶׁיְּקָרְבוּ כֻּלָּם אֵלָיו, כִּי חָפֵץ חֶסֶד הוּא. וְעַל כֵּן רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּנָה וְכַנַּ״ל.

(הלכות השכמת הבוקר הלכה ד׳ אות ט״ז)
breslov.en:
In every generation they dispute with the great tzaddikim who occupy themselves with drawing distant souls near to the Holy One, blessed be He.

“And Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings.”

(37:1)

And this is the aspect of the totality of the dispute in every generation against the complete tzaddikim who occupy themselves with drawing distant souls near to the Lord, blessed be He: very many rise against them, and also many of the great tzaddikim dispute with them, because the attribute of judgment clothes itself in them. And through this hatred enters their hearts, until it seems to them as though he does not conduct himself properly, and they dispute with him.

As has already happened in former times in most generations. And particularly in our days, in the footsteps of the Messiah, when contention among the Torah scholars has greatly increased; and especially against our great and awesome Rabbainu, of blessed holy and righteous memory, because he put his soul in jeopardy and occupied himself all his days with having compassion upon Israel, upon all the distant ones, to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

And this is the aspect of the dispute of the tribes against Yosef the tzaddik, for Yosef is the aspect of the tzaddik who occupies himself with drawing people near to the Lord, blessed be He, through continually adding to the light each day. For each time he makes wondrous contractions and vessels, in a manner in which anyone in the world who wishes can draw near. And on account of this he is called Yosef, the aspect of continually adding, as above. And the tribes, although they were all holy, for they were all great tzaddikim, disputed with him because of this.

And this is the aspect of “And Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings”; and our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded (Midrash Rabbah) that he would convert converts (as cited in his words, of blessed memory, part 1, section 228). And this is “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef.” Namely, Yosef walked in the way of his father Yaakov and also occupied himself with converting converts and drawing distant souls near, for everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef. This is the explanation of “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef,” as Rash״i explained there: that everything that he had received from Shem and Ever he transmitted to him, and everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef, etc. And all this is placed beside the verse “his father’s sojournings,” which is Yaakov’s converting converts; and immediately “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef” is placed beside it, meaning that he transmitted all his wisdom to him, as above—namely, as above.

Just as Yaakov converted converts through the might of his wisdom, for he knew how to make such contractions until he could heal those who were most ill, so Yosef the tzaddik continually occupied himself with this, for Yaakov transmitted all his wisdom to him. For the principal wisdom is to bring apprehensions of Godliness into the world, to make His mighty deeds known to the sons of man, etc.

And this is the aspect of “Yosef, seventeen years old, was shepherding his brothers among the sheep”: “shepherd of sheep” is the aspect of the leader of the generation, who is everywhere called a shepherd of sheep. And this is “he was seventeen years old,” etc. Seventeen is the numerical value of “good,” as cited; namely, Yosef was good to everyone and was wholly good. And through this he could draw everyone near, for he found good points in the worst of the worst, and through this drew them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

And this is “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc.: they are the sons of the bondwomen, the aspect of the lowly families among Israel, to whom he would lower himself especially in order to draw them near. And on account of this the distant ones are called sons of Bilhah and sons of Zilpah: this hints that the adversary and his forces have an especially strong hold on them. This is the aspect of “sons of Bilhah,” the aspect of “I shall make you terrors,” etc. (Ezekiel 26); and Rash״i explained there: demons—namely, the forces of the evil inclination, which are demons and klipos, that confuse, terrify, and cause a person to act wickedly. And this is the aspect of “sons of Zilpah,” the aspect of “Horror has seized me because of the wicked” (Psalms 119). For the forces of the evil inclination are the aspect of terrors and horrors, and all those held and drawn by them are called sons of Bilhah and sons of Zilpah.

And the great tzaddik, the aspect of Yosef, occupies himself with them and lowers himself to them in order to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc. And Rash״i explained that he would engage in youthful conduct, etc. For the true tzaddik, in the might of his wisdom, lowers himself to them so much that it seems as though he engages in youthful conduct: for he speaks ordinary conversation with them, eats and drinks with them, and sometimes strolls and plays with them. And his entire intention is to draw them near through this to the Lord, blessed be He. And it is understood from his words, of blessed memory, in several places (part 1, section 202; part 2, section 78), how very much the tzaddik lowers himself to the world, all of which is regarded by him as youthful conduct; but his intention is desired by the Lord, blessed be He, for it is to draw those very distant, who cannot be drawn near except through this, near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is the aspect of “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc., as above.

And therefore he is called Yosef, the aspect of “God has gathered away my reproach,” for he gathers away and nullifies all the reproaches and shames from Israel, because he brings them back in repentance and draws them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is the aspect of “May the Lord add a son for me,” on account of which he is called Yosef. Namely, the tzaddik continually occupies himself with adding and drawing new souls near each time, and continually asks the Lord, blessed be He, for this: the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me”—that the Lord should add for him each time a new student, who is called a son, for whoever teaches his fellow’s son Torah is as though he begot him (Sanhedrin 99). And he continually searches and seeks to add and draw new ones near, the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me.”

And therefore “And Israel loved Yosef more than all his sons, for he was a son of old age to him”: he loved him very much because of this, for he desires this, to have compassion upon everyone and to devise stratagems to draw everyone near. And this is “For he was a son of old age to him.” An elder is the aspect of very great mercies, the aspect of an elder full of mercies, the aspect of the thirteen rectifications of the beard, which are very great mercies. Namely, he received from him all thirteen attributes of mercy, which are the aspect of an elder, as above, for through this he has compassion upon everyone and draws them all near. And this is what Onkelos translated: “For he was a son of old age”—“for he was a wise son to him.” A wise son indeed, for this requires great wisdom, wondrous wisdom, very, very deep wisdom, so that he can make such vessels and contractions that he can draw such distant souls near, such ill people, and bring apprehensions of Godliness into them, as above.

And this is “And he made him a striped tunic,” whose meaning is a garment of fine wool with beautiful colors, the aspect of wool and blue thread. Namely, because he occupied himself with this, drawing distant souls near, therefore he made him wondrous garments with beautiful, proper, and wondrous colors, the aspect of a striped tunic. Namely, the aspect of wondrous contractions, which are the aspect of vessels and garments, so that through them he can draw apprehensions of Godliness even to those very distant, as above. For the aspect of these contractions, which are the aspect of the lower wisdom mentioned above, comprise all the colors, which are the totality of all the vessels and garments of holiness through which His Godliness, blessed be He, is apprehended, as is written in the holy Zohar several times: “And she comprises all the colors.”

And this is what they dreamed: “And behold, we are binding sheaves within the field,” whose meaning is bonds—namely, the aspect of the contractions mentioned above, which are the aspect of bonds, for contraction is the aspect of a bond. Namely, they all occupied themselves with this, binding sheaves and making bonds and contractions in order to draw through them apprehensions of Godliness. But the contractions and vessels of Yosef the tzaddik surpassed them all, in the aspect of (ibid.) “And behold, my sheaf arose and also stood,” etc., for his bond and contraction arose and also stood for all time and eternity.

“And behold, your sheaves came around and bowed to my sheaf”: that they all need to receive from him apprehensions of Godliness through the wondrous contractions that he makes with his deep wisdom, through continually occupying himself with drawing souls near. Through this he attained that even the great tzaddikim who occupy themselves with this, to attain apprehensions of Godliness through contractions, also need to receive from him, for his surpasses them all, in the aspect of (Proverbs 31) “Many daughters have done valiantly, but you have surpassed them all.” This is said concerning the greatest true tzaddik, who occupies himself with making vessels and garments and drawing Torah with such true wisdom that everyone can draw near to the Lord, blessed be He. This is the aspect of the praise of a woman of valor, etc., the aspect of “She sought wool and flax,” which are the aspect of vessels and garments for apprehensions of Godliness, etc.

And this is the aspect of “She was like merchant ships, from afar,” etc., “And she arose while it was still night and gave food to her household,” etc. For in the intensity of the darkness of the night of exile of the souls of Israel, she gives them food, etc. And thus this entire holy praise proceeds and revolves. And this is the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” which are the aspect of gates of the letters of Torah—namely, the aspect of these contractions which he draws with his wisdom, through which the Lord, blessed be He, is known in the world, the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” etc.

And this is “She opened her mouth with wisdom, and the Torah of kindness is upon her tongue.” And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded (Sotah 49): this is one who studies Torah in order to teach it—namely, as above, who teaches his Torah to others to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is “She watches the ways of her household”: he watches the course of his household, how he should conduct himself forever in a manner in which his lamp will never be extinguished, and in which the enduring remainder of his wisdom will remain for generations of generations, forever. For “And she shall not eat the bread of idleness,” for his bread and his Torah are not the bread of idleness, Heaven forbid, for he was very, very diligent in His service, blessed be He. Therefore “her sons arose and called her fortunate”: these are the students, called sons, whom he drew near to the Lord, blessed be He. “Her husband, and he praised her”—this is the Lord, blessed be He, for the Lord, blessed be He, agrees to this, for He desires this, that they should draw everyone near to Him, for He desires kindness. And therefore “Many daughters have done valiantly, but you have surpassed them all,” as above.

(Halachos of Rising in the Morning, Halacha 4, item 16)

pairs.he: דָּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה ׳מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ לְשׁוֹן גֵּרִים שֶׁהָיָה יַעֲקֹב מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים. וְאִיתָא בִּדְבָרָיו זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּסִימָן רכח שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בִּקֵּשׁ יַעֲקֹב לֵישֵׁב בְּשַׁלְוָה קָפַץ עָלָיו רָגְזוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף, כִּי זֶה שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים, בְּהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ יִסּוּרִים וּמַחֲלֹקֶת וְכוּ׳ וְכֵן הוּא בְּכָל אָדָם.
pairs.en: Our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded in Midrash Rabbah “his father’s sojournings” as an expression of converts, for Yaakov would convert converts. And it is stated in his words, of blessed memory, in section 228 [candidate printed numeral רכח], that this is the aspect of what our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: Yaakov wished to dwell in tranquility; the trouble of Yosef sprang upon him. For one who occupies himself with converting converts necessarily has suffering and dispute, etc.; and so it is with every person.

pairs.he: שֶׁאֵלּוּ הַגֵּרִים וּבַעֲלֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה הָרוֹצִים לָשׁוּב אֶל ה׳ עַל יְדֵי הַצַּדִּיק, בְּהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה עֲלֵיהֶם גַּם כֵּן כַּמָּה מִינֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת וְיִסּוּרִים וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת וְכוּ׳ בְּכָל פַּעַם, כִּי אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהִתְקָרֵב בֶּאֱמֶת לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי זֶה, כַּמְבֹאָר בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה בָּזֶה. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בְּסִימָן ע״ב שֶׁהוּא לְהִתְחַזֵּק בְּכָל פַּעַם כְּנֶגֶד הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע וְכוּ׳ עַיֵּן שָׁם.
pairs.en: For these converts and penitents who wish to return to the Lord through the tzaddik necessarily also undergo several kinds of dispute, suffering, and overpowering, etc., each time. For it is impossible to draw near in truth to the Lord, blessed be He, except through this, as explained at length in our words on this. And as explained in section 72, which is to strengthen oneself each time against the evil inclination, etc.; see there.

For it is impossible to draw near in truth to the Lord, blessed be He, except through this, as explained at length in our words on this. pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן עַל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הָרוֹצֶה לָשׁוּב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ נֶאֱמַר בִּקֵּשׁ יַעֲקֹב לֵישֵׁב בְּשַׁלְוָה קָפַץ עָלָיו וְכוּ׳. וְהַתִּקּוּן לְכָל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף בְּעַצְמוֹ, בִּבְחִינַת אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף, וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י הַפִּשְׁתָּנִי הַזֶּה נִכְנְסוּ גְּמַלָּיו טְעוּנִים פִּשְׁתָּן הַפֶּחָמִי תָּמָה אָנָה יִכְנֹס כָּל הַפִּשְׁתָּן הַזֶּה, הָיָה פִּקֵּחַ אֶחָד הֵשִׁיב לוֹ נִיצוֹץ אֶחָד יוֹצֵא מִמַּפּוּחַ שֶׁלְּךָ שֶׁשּׂוֹרֵף כָּל הַפִּשְׁתָּן, כֵּן וְכוּ׳, וְהָיָה בֵּית יַעֲקֹב אֵשׁ וּבֵית יוֹסֵף לֶהָבָה וּבֵית עֵשָׂו לְקַשׁ נִיצוֹץ יוֹצֵא מִיּוֹסֵף שֶׁמְּכַלֶּה וְשׂוֹרֵף הַכֹּל.
pairs.en: And therefore concerning each and every person of Israel who wishes to return to the Lord, blessed be He, it is said: Yaakov wished to dwell in tranquility; there sprang upon him, etc. And the rectification for all this is the aspect of Yosef himself, in the aspect of “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef.” And Rash״i explained: This flax dealer’s camels came in laden with flax; the charcoal burner wondered, where will all this flax enter? One discerning person answered him: one spark comes out of your bellows that burns all the flax. So, etc., “And the house of Yaakov shall be fire, and the house of Yosef a flame, and the house of Esav straw”: a spark comes out of Yosef that consumes and burns everything.

pairs.he: כִּי יַעֲקֹב רָאָה כָּל הָאַלּוּפִים הַכְּתוּבִים לְמַעְלָה תָּמָה וְכוּ׳ מַה כְּתִיב לְמַטָּה אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף וְכוּ׳ נִיצוֹץ אֶחָד וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן פֵּרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י בְּפָסוּק וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה רָחֵל אֶת יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֵנִי וְכוּ׳ וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י מִשֶּׁנּוֹלַד שִׂטְנוֹ שֶׁל עֵשָׂו וְכוּ׳ אֵין אֵשׁ בְּלֹא לֶהָבָה אֵינוֹ שׁוֹלֵט וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: For Yaakov saw all the chieftains written above and wondered, etc. What is written below? “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef,” etc.—one spark, etc. And likewise Rash״i explained concerning the verse “And it was when Rachel bore Yosef, and he said, ‘Send me away,’” etc. Rash״i explained: once Esav’s antagonist was born, etc.; fire without a flame does not rule, etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: For Yaakov saw all the chieftains written above and wondered, etc. What is written below? “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef,” etc.—one spark, etc. And likewise Rash״i explained concerning the verse “And it was when Rachel bore Yosef, and he said, ‘Send me away,’” etc. Rash״i explained: once Esav’s antagonist was born, etc.; fire without a flame does not rule, etc.

pairs.he: הַיְנוּ כִּי יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת שֶׁיָּכוֹל לְשַׂמֵּחַ אֶת לֵב כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וּלְהַפֵּךְ הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה מַלְהִיב אֶת לֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בְּסִימָן ט בְּלִקּוּטֵי תִּנְיָנָא כִּי הַצַּדִּיק הוּא בְּחִינַת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ בּוֹ שֶׁמְּנַשֵּׁב הָעַפְרוּרִיּוּת שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עַצְבוּת, מִלֵּב אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי, כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהִתְלַהֵב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְכוּ׳ עַיֵּן שָׁם.
pairs.en: Namely, Yosef is the aspect of the true tzaddik who can gladden the heart of each person of Israel and turn sorrow and sighing into joy, through which he sets the heart of Israel aflame toward the Lord, blessed be He. And as explained in section 9 of Likutay Tinyana, the tzaddik is the aspect of “a man in whom there is spirit,” who blows away the dustiness, which is the aspect of sadness, from the heart of an Israelite person, so that he can be set aflame toward the Lord, blessed be He, etc.; see there.

qualifiedAfter.en: Namely, Yosef is the aspect of the true tzaddik who can gladden the heart of each person of Israel and turn sorrow and sighing into joy, through which he sets the heart of Israel aflame toward the Lord, blessed be He. pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בּוֹ הֲנִמְצָא כָּזֶה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ אֱלֹקִים בּוֹ, כִּי יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁיָּכוֹל לֵירֵד לְתוֹךְ כָּל הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת וּלְהוֹצִיא כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת מִשָּׁם, כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד מֵעֹמֶק נְפִילָתוֹ, כָּל מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לְהִתְאַחֵז בּוֹ, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה כְּלָל מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן כְּשֶׁחוֹלֵק וְכוּ׳ בְּוַדַּאי אִי אֶפְשָׁר לַעֲזֹר לוֹ, וְעָלָיו נֶאֱמַר בְּאָזְנֵי כְסִיל אַל תְּדַבֵּר כִּי יָבוּז לְשֵׂכֶל מִלֶּיךָ, אֲבָל כָּל מִי שֶׁחָס עַל נַפְשׁוֹ עֲדַיִן וְחָפֵץ בְּחַיִּים אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁנָּפַל כְּמוֹ שֶׁנָּפַל, יָכוֹל הַצַּדִּיק בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף לְהוֹצִיאוֹ מִשָּׁם.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of Yosef, concerning whom it is said: “Can there be found such a man in whom there is the spirit of God?” For Yosef is the aspect of the tzaddik who can descend into all the chambers of exchanges and bring out all the souls from there, each and every one from the depth of his fall, anyone who wishes to hold onto him. For certainly one who does not wish at all, and all the more so when he disputes, etc., certainly cannot be helped; and concerning him it is said, “Do not speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the intellect of your words.” But anyone who still has compassion on his soul and desires life, even though he has fallen as he has fallen, the tzaddik, the aspect of Yosef, can bring him out from there.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of Yosef, concerning whom it is said: “Can there be found such a man in whom there is the spirit of God?” For Yosef is the aspect of the tzaddik who can descend into all the chambers of exchanges and bring out all the souls from there, each and every one from the depth of his fall, anyone who wishes to hold onto him. For certainly one who does not wish at all, and all the more so when he disputes, etc., certainly cannot be helped; and concerning him it is said, “Do not speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the intellect of your words.” But anyone who still has compassion on his soul and desires life, even though he has fallen as he has fallen, the tzaddik, the aspect of Yosef, can bring him out from there.

pairs.he: כִּי יוֹסֵף יָרַד לְכָל הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, בִּבְחִינַת לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף, עַבְדוּת בְּחִינַת עַצְבוּת כַּמּוּבָא בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר, שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ מִזֻּהֲמַת הַנָּחָשׁ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת חָם שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ יָצָא מִצְרַיִם שֶׁנִּתְקַלֵּל עֶבֶד עֲבָדִים יִהְיֶה וְכוּ׳ כַּמּוּבָא, וְיוֹסֵף עָבַר בְּכָל זֶה וְהָיָה לוֹ נִסְיוֹנוֹת עֲצוּמִים בְּתַאֲוָה זֹאת שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ מֵעַצְבוּת, וְהָיָה בְּבֵית הָאֲסוּרִים כַּמָּה שָׁנִים, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה עָבַר בְּכָל בְּחִינוֹת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת וְיָצָא מֵהֶם בְּשָׁלוֹם, אַף גַּם זָכָה לְתוֹסֶפֶת קְדֻשָּׁה עֲצוּמָה עַל יְדֵי זֶה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת ׳יוֹסֵף יוֹסֵף׳ בְּחִינַת יִשְׁמַע חָכָם וְיוֹסֵף לֶקַח. וְעַל כֵּן יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה לְהַפֵּךְ הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה.
pairs.en: For Yosef descended into all the chambers of exchanges, in the aspect of “Yosef was sold as a slave”—slavery being the aspect of sadness, as cited elsewhere, which is drawn from the filth of the serpent, which is the aspect of Cham, from whom Egypt came forth, who was cursed, “A slave of slaves he shall be,” etc., as cited. And Yosef passed through all this and had immense trials in this desire, which is drawn from sadness, and was in prison for several years. And through this he passed through all the aspects of the chambers of exchanges and came out of them in peace; indeed, he also attained an immense addition of holiness through this. This is the aspect of “Yosef, Yosef,” the aspect of “A wise man shall hear and add learning.” And therefore he has the power to turn everything to good, to turn sorrow and sighing into joy.

qualifiedAfter.en: For Yosef descended into all the chambers of exchanges, in the aspect of “Yosef was sold as a slave”—slavery being the aspect of sadness, as cited elsewhere, which is drawn from the filth of the serpent, which is the aspect of Cham, from whom Egypt came forth, who was cursed, “A slave of slaves he shall be,” etc., as cited. pairs.he: שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁהִתְנַבְּאָה רָחֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר נוֹלַד יוֹסֵף וְאָמְרָה אָסַף אֱלֹקִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִי, כִּי עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁיָּכוֹל לַעֲבֹר בְּכָל הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת וְלָצֵאת מִשָּׁם בְּשָׁלוֹם עַל יְדֵי זֶה יִתְבַּטְּלוּ כָּל הַחֲרָפוֹת הַבָּאִין מִשָּׁם, וְאַחַר כָּךְ קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ יוֹסֵף לֵאמֹר יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר, הַיְנוּ שֶׁאָמְרָה שֶׁלֹּא דַּי שֶׁעַל יָדוֹ יִתְבַּטְּלוּ הַחֲרָפוֹת בְּחִינַת אָסַף אֱלֹקִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִי, אַף גַּם יִהְיֶה לוֹ כֹּחַ לְהַפֵּךְ הַחֲרָפוֹת לְכָבוֹד לְהַפֵּךְ הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר, בְּחִינַת מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים הַמְּשַׂמְּחִים הַלֵּב בְּחִינַת בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח אָב, כִּי עִקַּר תּוֹלְדוֹתֵיהֶן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים הֵם מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים, הַיְנוּ שֶׁדַּיְקָא עַל יְדֵי הַחֲרָפוֹת וְכוּ׳ יוֹסֵף בֵּן אַחֵר שֶׁהוּא תּוֹלָדָה דִּקְדֻשָּׁה לְהוֹסִיף וּלְהוֹלִיד עַל יְדֵי זֶה דַּיְקָא שִׂמְחָה וְטוֹב בִּבְחִינַת הִתְהַפְּכוּת הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה.
pairs.en: This is the aspect of what Rachel prophesied when Yosef was born, saying “God has gathered away my reproach.” For through the aspect of Yosef the tzaddik, who can pass through all the chambers of exchanges and come out of there in peace, through this all the reproaches coming from there will be nullified. And afterwards she called his name Yosef, saying “May the Lord add another son for me.” Namely, she said that it was not enough that through him the reproaches should be nullified, the aspect of “God has gathered away my reproach”; rather, he would also have the power to turn the reproaches into honor, to turn sorrow and sighing into joy. This is the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me,” the aspect of good deeds that gladden the heart, the aspect of “A wise son shall gladden a father.” For the principal offspring of tzaddikim are good deeds. Namely, specifically through the reproaches, etc., another son shall be added, who is a holy offspring, to add and bring forth through this specifically joy and goodness, in the aspect of turning sorrow and sighing into joy.

This is the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me,” the aspect of good deeds that gladden the heart, the aspect of “A wise son shall gladden a father.” For the principal offspring of tzaddikim are good deeds. Namely, specifically through the reproaches, etc., another son shall be added, who is a holy offspring, to add and bring forth through this specifically joy and goodness, in the aspect of turning sorrow and sighing into joy.

pairs.he: שֶׁכָּל זֶה בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב ׳לְמִחְיָה שְׁלָחַנִי אֱלֹקִים לִפְנֵיכֶם׳ וְכוּ׳, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב ׳וְאַתֶּם חֲשַׁבְתֶּם לְרָעָה אֱלֹקִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה לְמַעַן עֲשֹׂה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַחֲיֹת עַם רָב׳. וְאִיתָא בְּסְפָרִים עַל זֶה, אַשְׁרֵיהֶם בַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה כִּי לְמִחְיָה שְׁלָחַנִי אֱלֹקִים וְכוּ׳. וּלְשָׁם הַמְּקוֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר נָפְצוּ שָׁם לְקָרֵב נִיצוֹצֵי קְדֻשָּׁה לִמְקוֹמָם וְכוּ׳, שֶׁכָּל זֶה בְּחִינַת יְרִידָה תַּכְלִית הָעֲלִיָּה בִּבְחִינַת הַנַּ״ל שֶׁנִּתְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה לְשָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה וְכַנַּ״ל. וְעַל כֵּן דַּיְקָא בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף יָכוֹל לְהַלְהִיב אֶת הַלֵּב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִשְׂרֹף אֶת כָּל בְּחִינַת אַלּוּפֵי עֵשָׂו וְיַהֲפֹךְ הַכֹּל לְשִׂמְחָה וּלְטוֹבָה.
pairs.en: For all this is the aspect of Yosef, as it is written, “God sent me before you for preservation of life,” etc.; and as it is written, “And you intended evil, but God intended it for good, in order to do as on this day, to keep a numerous people alive.” And it is stated in books concerning this: fortunate are the penitents, for “God sent me for preservation of life,” etc. And to those places where they were scattered, to draw sparks of holiness near to their place, etc. All this is the aspect of descent for the ultimate purpose of ascent, in the aspect mentioned above, that everything is turned to good, to gladness and joy, as above. And therefore specifically the aspect of Yosef can set the heart aflame toward the Lord, blessed be He, and through this burn all the aspect of Esav’s chieftains and turn everything to joy and good.

qualifiedAfter.en: For all this is the aspect of Yosef, as it is written, “God sent me before you for preservation of life,” etc.; and as it is written, “And you intended evil, but God intended it for good, in order to do as on this day, to keep a numerous people alive.” And it is stated in books concerning this: fortunate are the penitents, for “God sent me for preservation of life,” etc. And to those places where they were scattered, to draw sparks of holiness near to their place, etc. All this is the aspect of descent for the ultimate purpose of ascent, in the aspect mentioned above, that everything is turned to good, to gladness and joy, as above. And therefore specifically the aspect of Yosef can set the heart aflame toward the Lord, blessed be He, and through this burn all the aspect of Esav’s chieftains and turn everything to joy and good.

pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב וַיֵּשֶׁב׳ דַּיְקָא, בְּחִינַת מֹחַ הַמְסֻדָּר וְהַמְיֻשָּׁב שֶׁזָּכָה יַעֲקֹב בְּחִינַת הַשֵּׂכֶל הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁרוֹדֵף תָּמִיד לְהַשִּׂיג הָאוֹר אֵין סוֹף וְכוּ׳ כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי הַשֵּׂכֶל נִקְרָא יַעֲקֹב כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים. וְזֶה וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב שֶׁזָּכָה לִבְחִינַת הַמְסֻדָּר וְהַמְיֻשָּׁב. וְזֶה בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהָיָה מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מִי יִמָּר הַנַּ״ל שֶׁיָּכוֹל לֵירֵד לְהֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת וְכוּ׳. אַךְ בְּכָל פַּעַם מִתְגָּרִים בּוֹ וְהַנִּלְוִים אֵלָיו מְאֹד מְאֹד וּמַנִּיחִים אוֹתוֹ וְכוּ׳ לֵישֵׁב בְּשַׁלְוָה כַּנַּ״ל. וְהַתִּקּוּן לְזֶה הוּא אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף וְכוּ׳, שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק בְּחִינַת יַעֲקֹב בְּחִינַת הַשֵּׂכֶל הַקָּדוֹשׁ מוֹלִיד בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תּוֹסֶפֶת קְדֻשָּׁה בְּכָל פַּעַם, כִּי אֵינוֹ נוֹפֵל לְזִקְנָה דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן, רַק הוּא מוֹסִיף קְדֻשָּׁה וָדַעַת בְּכָל פַּעַם עַד שֶׁיָּכוֹל לְהַפֵּךְ כָּל הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה, בִּבְחִינַת ׳יוֹסֵף עֲדֵינָה בְּשִׂמְחָה׳ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And this is “And Yaakov dwelt”—“dwelt” specifically, the aspect of the ordered and settled mind that Yaakov attained, the aspect of the holy intellect which continually pursues the apprehension of the light of the Infinite, etc., as above. For intellect is called Yaakov, as explained several times. And this is “And Yaakov dwelt”: he attained the aspect of being ordered and settled. And this is “in the land of his father’s sojournings,” through his converting converts, which is the aspect of the “mi yimmar” mentioned above [candidate technical phrase, unresolved], who can descend to the chambers of exchanges, etc. But each time they provoke him and those accompanying him very, very much, and leave him, etc., to dwell in tranquility, as above. And the rectification for this is “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef,” etc.: that the tzaddik, the aspect of Yaakov, the aspect of the holy intellect, brings forth in his holiness the aspect of Yosef, which is the aspect of an addition of holiness each time. For he does not fall into old age of the other side in any manner; rather, he adds holiness and understanding each time, until he can turn all sorrow and sighing into joy, in the aspect of “Yosef adinah with joy” [candidate quoted phrase, unresolved], etc.

pairs.he: וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה בְּחִינַת בֵּית יוֹסֵף לֶהָבָה שֶׁמַּלְהִיב אֵשׁ הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב כִּי הוּא אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ אֱלֹקִים בּוֹ שֶׁמְּנַשֵּׁב הָעַפְרוּרִיּוּת מִכָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כַּנַּ״ל, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִיצוֹץ אֶחָד יוֹצֵא מִבְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף שֶׁשּׂוֹרֵף אֶת כָּל אַלּוּפֵי עֵשָׂו שֶׁהֵם כְּלַל כָּל הַמְּנִיעוֹת וְהַסִּטְרִין אַחֲרָנִין שֶׁמֵּהֶם כָּל הָעַצְבוּת וְהַחֲלִישׁוּת הַדַּעַת וְהַהִתְגַּבְּרוּת וְכוּ׳ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר עַל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד, כִּי עַל יְדֵי נִיצוֹץ אֶחָד שֶׁל אוֹר הָאֱמֶת שֶׁמַּכְנִיס בְּלֵב אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי עַד שֶׁמַּלְהִיב אֶת לִבּוֹ לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ, עַל יְדֵי זֶה מְכַלֶּה וְשׂוֹרֵף אֶת כָּל הַמּוֹנְעִים וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And through this the aspect of the house of Yosef as a flame is made, which sets aflame Yaakov’s fire of holiness, for he is a man in whom there is the spirit of God, who blows away the dustiness from every person of Israel, as above. And through this one spark goes out from the aspect of Yosef that burns all of Esav’s chieftains, which are the totality of all the impediments and the other sides, from which come all the sadness, discouragement, and overpowering, etc., etc., that overpower each and every person. For through one spark of the light of truth that he brings into the heart of an Israelite person until he sets his heart aflame toward the Lord, blessed be He, through this he consumes and burns all those that prevent, etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: And through this the aspect of the house of Yosef as a flame is made, which sets aflame Yaakov’s fire of holiness, for he is a man in whom there is the spirit of God, who blows away the dustiness from every person of Israel, as above. And through this one spark goes out from the aspect of Yosef that burns all of Esav’s chieftains, which are the totality of all the impediments and the other sides, from which come all the sadness, discouragement, and overpowering, etc., etc., that overpower each and every person. For through one spark of the light of truth that he brings into the heart of an Israelite person until he sets his heart aflame toward the Lord, blessed be He, through this he consumes and burns all those that prevent, etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת יוֹסֵף מִכָּל בָּנָיו כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳. זְקֻנִים לְשׁוֹן רַבִּים, כִּי הוּא עוֹסֵק תָּמִיד לְהַגְבִּיר בְּכָל פַּעַם הַזִּקְנָה דִּקְדֻשָּׁה עַל בְּחִינַת הַזִּקְנָה דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא, כִּי יֵשׁ זָקֵן דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא שֶׁעוֹסֵק תָּמִיד לְהַפִּיל אֶת הָאָדָם לִידֵי זִקְנָה הַיְנוּ לְהַחֲלִישׁ אֶת דַּעְתּוֹ כְּאִלּוּ הוּא זָקֵן בְּמַעֲשָׂיו וְכוּ׳, שֶׁעַל זֶה הִזְהִיר אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה וְכֵן שָׁמַעְנוּ מִכַּמָּה צַדִּיקִים שֶׁאָסוּר לִהְיוֹת זָקֵן וְכוּ׳, וּמַכְנִיעוֹ עַל יְדֵי זָקֵן דִּקְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת זָקֵן וְיוֹשֵׁב בִּישִׁיבָה הָאֲמִתִּי בְּחִינַת זָקֵן זֶה קָנָה חָכְמָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף שֶׁהוּא מוֹסִיף קְדֻשָּׁה וְחִיּוּת בְּכָל פַּעַם וְכַנַּ״ל. וּכְבָר מְבֹאָר מִזֶּה בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה (ועיין בהלכות תפילין הלכה ה).
pairs.en: And this is “And Israel loved Yosef more than all his sons, for he was a son of old age to him.” Zekunim is a plural expression, for he continually occupies himself with strengthening, each time, holy old age over the aspect of old age of the other side. For there is an elder of the other side who continually occupies himself with bringing a person down into old age—namely, weakening his understanding as though he were old in his deeds, etc. Concerning this our master, teacher, and Rabbainu, of blessed memory, warned, and likewise we have heard from several tzaddikim, that it is forbidden to be old, etc. And he subdues it through the holy elder, who is the aspect of the true elder who sits in the academy, the aspect of “elder—this one acquired wisdom,” which is the aspect of Yosef, who adds holiness and vitality each time, as above. And much of this has already been explained in our words (and see Halachos of Tefillin, Halacha 5).

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳ לְשׁוֹן רַבִּים, שֶׁבְּכָל פַּעַם מוֹסִיף זִקְנָה דִּקְדֻשָּׁה עַל זִקְנָה דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת וְיִרְאַת ה׳ מוֹסִיף יָמִים, לְהַכְנִיעַ וּלְבַטֵּל בְּחִינַת זָקֵן דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא שֶׁעַל זֶה הִתְפַּלֵּל דָּוִד אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה וְכוּ׳. כִּי צְרִיכִין לְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל פַּעַם מֵחָדָשׁ בִּבְחִינַת וְקוֹיֵ ה׳ יַחֲלִיפוּ כֹחַ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר בְּחִינַת זִקְנָה דִּקְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁנִּקְרָא עַל שֵׁם זֶה יוֹסֵף עַל שֵׁם שֶׁהוּא מוֹסִיף קְדֻשָּׁה וָדַעַת שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר הַחִיּוּת בְּכָל פַּעַם וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “For he was a son of old age to him,” a plural expression: each time he adds holy old age upon holy old age—which is the aspect of “And the fear of the Lord adds days,” to subdue and nullify the aspect of the elder of the other side, concerning which Dovid prayed, “Do not cast me away at the time of old age,” etc. For one needs to renew oneself anew each time, in the aspect of “And those who hope in the Lord shall renew their strength,” etc. This is the principal aspect of holy old age, which is the aspect of Yosef the tzaddik, who is called Yosef on account of this, on account of his adding holiness and understanding, which is the principal vitality, each time, as above.
